editorial:
You follow a tight crew of Boston bank robbers who pull off a job and take a manager hostage, then one thief starts falling for her. The story mixes tense heists with messy feelings, so you get both action and drama. The neighborhood setting feels real, and the characters feel like people you might know, even when they make bad choices. It keeps you hooked because every plan has a cost, and every relationship gets tested.

The acting is very strong, the action is truly sharp, and the pacing almost never slows down. You may notice some familiar crime-movie beats, but the emotional stakes make them work really well. It is also great for viewers who want a smart thriller with heart, not just shootouts. Watch it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture and sound.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the crew’s last job at Fenway Park goes wrong. Jem is killed during the shootout, and Doug barely escapes. He leaves town and sends Claire a hidden bag of money, then watches her from a distance as she finds it. The movie ends with Doug starting over somewhere quiet, while Claire keeps the money and moves on.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves tense crime thrillers with strong characters.
